verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken three-column layout. The body copy is squeezed into a narrow right column with choppy one- and two-word lines, the badges and the SUNSET SALE ribbon are scattered at bottom left with mismatched sizes and 'AWARD WINNING' left unboxed, the CTA is tiny and pushed off to the side, and a 'missing asset' placeholder is visible. A is worse because its headline is crammed into 10 lines that run almost from the top edge to the bottom edge. B sets the same headline in 7 lines with more breathing room and better vertical centring.
